name: Molly Woodland
original_name: モリィ・ウッドランド
source:
A young undertaker who never loses his smile, even when looking at a corpse.
He has a beautiful and ephemeral appearance, like a prince from a fairy tale. For some reason, he's good at escaping from ropes and picking locks.
He's said to have attacked a group of travelling merchants on the highway.
